title: ReadinessFinding
description: One thing readiness discovery found, or did not find, about a requirement (master plan 9.5, ADR 0037). It is advisory: it is evidence of what the project contains, never a certification, an authorisation or an audit result. Every finding that says something is covered (found, partial) or contradicted cites evidence, and a deterministic verifier re-reads every cited span and re-hashes the file; a finding that does not confirm is unverified and says why. A finding a model proposed is model_verified only when the verifier confirmed it, and model_unverified findings are always unverified: they never count as covered. The model cannot change a status a rule decided.

schema_version.description: The contract generation of this document.

finding_id.description: The stable ID of the finding.

requirement_id.description: The catalog requirement this finding is about.

category.description: What kind of thing the finding is about; the category of its requirement.

status.description: Whether the finding shows the requirement covered. unverified never counts as covered.

source.description: Who produced the finding: a rule, a model whose evidence the verifier confirmed, or a model whose evidence did not confirm.

check_id.description: The integration audit check this finding feeds; the check of its requirement.

evidence.description: Where the finding comes from. At least one entry unless the status is missing or unverified, because a finding without evidence cannot be found, partial or contradicted.

summary.description: What was found, in a sentence. Secret-looking values are redacted before they reach this text.

unverified_reason.description: Why the evidence did not confirm, or why the status could not be determined. Present when the status is unverified.

remediation.description: What to do to cover the requirement. For a finding that already shows the requirement covered this says what, if anything, is left to do.

evidence.description: One cited span of one file. The path is relative to the scanned root; the verifier re-reads the span and re-hashes the whole file, and the entry confirms only when the file still has this hash and the span exists.

path.description: The file, relative to the scanned root.

line_start.description: The first cited line, counting from 1.

line_end.description: The last cited line, counting from 1; not before line_start (the verifier rejects a span that ends before it starts or past the end of the file).

file_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the whole file when it was scanned.
